description: This file defines the FixedGridLayout class, a custom ViewGroup for arranging its child views in a grid with fixed cell sizes, used within Android UI layouts.

classes.name: FixedGridLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges its child views in a grid with fixed cell dimensions, supporting setting cell width and height and handling layout and measurement.

methods.name: FixedGridLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FixedGridLayout with the given Context.

methods.name: setCellWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of each cell in pixels and requests layout update.

methods.name: setCellHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of each cell in pixels and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the size requirements for this layout and its children, considering fixed cell sizes, to determine its overall size.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions child views within this layout in a grid, centering each within its cell and handling multiple rows.
